# /crav1-read-environment

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a named host](../../from-read-environment.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-read-environment/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Read the host the user named.

When the user names a host, **[`/crav1-read-environment`](crav1-read-environment.md)** reads every non-prod environment on that host in one pass. Examples: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud. It does not guess the host. Naming production, prod, or live stops. It never reads production data. This build has readers for Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. Any other host stops with no reader. It does not read Azure DevOps, GitHub, or CI. The user names the host, not the subscription, the account, or the project. Each seen line keeps its own environment. A prod-only resource has a production mark and no non-prod twin. Pre-prod, resources shared with prod, and prod-only resources are shape and connections only, after one yes. A no leaves prod-only skipped. A line from that yes says `prod only`. After that read, and before any section, it can look inside a database or storage when the user says yes. SQL is metadata only. Storage is structure only. It never reads a row or a blob. Production is never opened. The only file this command writes is `docs/environments/marks.md`, by appending a line the user confirmed. After a section is confirmed, the skill that already owns the file adds only what is new. A fact is seen in that environment. A link, including a trigger definition, is added only when the environment shows the connection. It is cross-cutting. It is not a lane. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build.

The user names the host. One pass reads every non-prod environment. Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud readers. Any other host stops with no reader. Naming production, prod, or live stops. Never production data. Pre-prod, shared-with-prod, and prod-only are shape and connections only, after one yes. A no leaves prod-only skipped. After that read, optional SQL metadata and storage structure, only when the user says yes. Never rows, blobs, or production. Look-inside never opens production. Appends confirmed lines to `docs/environments/marks.md`. Does not write `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, a feature spec, or `docs/architecture/left-out.md`. After a confirmed section, the owner adds only what is new. A fact is seen in that environment. A link only when the environment shows the connection. Does not start Specify, Plan, or Build.

## Runs when

The user names the host. Called by the user.

This is one of the six starter options. Asking for startup options names it and does not run it.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 3 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Non-prod resources on that host.

Reads the host the user named, non-prod resources on that host, prod-only resources for shape and connections when the user says yes, and `docs/environments/marks.md` when it exists. After that read, optional SQL metadata and storage structure only when the user says yes.

## Writes

In short: Confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md`; confirmed sections go to their owners through [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md), [`/crav1-existing-to-specs`](crav1-existing-to-specs.md), or [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md).

Writes only confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md` and (1.69.0) `docs/environments/promotion.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, feature specs, `docs/architecture/left-out.md`, and application code alone.

Limits and exceptions: does not guess the host. Naming production, prod, or live stops. One pass covers every non-prod environment. Pre-prod, shared-with-prod, and prod-only stay shape and connections until one yes. A no leaves prod-only in Skipped. Look-inside never opens production. A database with no clear environment is asked before it is opened. Missing access stops that look-inside. Never rows, blobs, or production data. Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud each have a reader. Any other host stops with no reader. A fact is seen in that environment. A prod-only line says `prod only`. A link only when the environment shows the connection. Does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. Names [`/crav1-map-pipeline-environments`](crav1-map-pipeline-environments.md) and does not run it. After `marks.md` lines are added, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md) and does not run that refresh from the question.

- You run next: [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md), [`/crav1-existing-to-specs`](crav1-existing-to-specs.md), and [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for the append only after that section is confirmed.
